title: VideoML standard pipeline (Python): move from Threat Intelligence into `papyrus videos`, brand-configured
description:
## Goal
VideoML as a standard Papyrus capability (decision 9): the Python side of Threat Intelligence's video pipeline (script DSL generation, narration/TTS, render orchestration, attach rendered MP4 to items) moves from `publications/threat_intelligence/videoml/` into the package as `papyrus videos ...`, with every TI-specific constant (slugs, colors, paths, output dirs) supplied by the publication through configuration. This ticket is Python/CLI only; browser playback and the preview bundle are `PPY-961956`.

## Context (verified; sources read on 2026-10-05)
- Papyrus `develop` has an OLD, TI-hardcoded copy: `publications/threat_intelligence/videoml/{video_pipeline.py (836 lines), videos_commands.py, __init__.py}`: constants `TI_BROWSER_BUNDLE`, `TI_SEED_PROFILE`, `TI_VIDEO_OUTPUT_DIR`, `TI_SEED_CONTENT_PATH`, `LEAD_VIDEO_SLUGS` (6 TI article slugs), `TI_SCENE_STYLES_DARK`, `DEFAULT_VIDEOML_CLI = ~/Projects/VideoML/cli`, `DEFAULT_BABULUS_ROOT = ~/Projects/Babulus` (L14-50; subprocess calls L640-800). `src/papyrus_content/cli.py` L200 imports `videos_attach, videos_render, videos_seed` from it (made lazy by `PPY-78e818`); commands `videos:render`, `videos:seed`, `videos:attach` are in `PORTED_COMMANDS`. `publications/` is not in the wheel, so this code cannot ship until moved.
- The CURRENT source of truth is the Threat-Intelligence repo `main` (sha 90582117355e3ff724d1abef554454d64bf6b432 on 2026-10-05): `publications/threat_intelligence/videoml/video_pipeline.py` (56 KB), `videos_commands.py` (13.5 KB), `videos_dsl.py` (11 KB), `seed-video-catalog.ts`, `preview-bundle.tsx`, `browser-bundle.tsx`, `ti-title-slide.tsx`, `ti-quote-card.tsx`, `ti-video-rhythm.ts`, `pictogram-video.tsx`; tests `publications/threat_intelligence/tests/test_video_pipeline.py` (21 KB) and `test-video-script.cjs`; docs `publications/threat_intelligence/docs/video-pipeline.md`; skill `publications/threat_intelligence/skills/produce-video/SKILL.md` (21 KB, TI voice and branding: stays in the TI repo as the brand skill, with its generic parts moving to a Papyrus skill). Read them with `gh api repos/AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence/contents/<path> --jq .content | base64 -d` (read-only; never push to that repo).
- VideoML toolchain is published: npm `@videoml/toolchain` 1.0.0 and `@videoml/cli` 1.0.0 (repo `AnthusAI/videoml-toolchain`, public, MIT; the earlier `~/Projects/Babulus` / `~/Projects/VideoML` checkouts are legacy paths). `docs/video-pipeline.md` describes `vml pipeline` invoked as a subprocess, OpenAI TTS config via `.papyrus/config.yaml` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` (`src/papyrus_content/papyrus_config.py` `resolve_openai_api_key`, `resolve_openai_tts_defaults`).
- The same file is being de-forked in Phase 3 (TI): this ticket is the upstream target for that diff class ("VideoML pipeline" row of docs/standard-site.md 3.2). Do not touch the TI repo.

## Exact changes
0. Step 0 (record in the ticket before coding): in a scratch dir `npm i @videoml/cli@1.0.0` and run `npx vml --help`; confirm the subcommand used by `video_pipeline.py` (`pipeline <dsl> --project-dir <dir> --out <mp4>`, L658-668) still exists in 1.0.0 and note any CLI differences from the Babulus path. Decide, and write in the ticket, how the CLI is located: env `VIDEOML_CLI` (explicit) else `npx --no-install vml` from the publication's `node_modules` (publication lists `@videoml/cli` as a devDependency). Remove the `~/Projects/...` defaults.
1. Move to `src/papyrus_content/videoml/` (new package; `__init__.py`, `pipeline.py`, `commands.py`, `dsl.py`) from TI main (not from Papyrus's older copy), then genericize: replace every `TI_*` constant by a `VideoConfig` object loaded from the publication: `papyrus.config.ts`'s `brand.video` (`PPY-961956` defines the TS side) is mirrored for Python by a YAML file `video/video.yml` in the publication repo (path from env `PAPYRUS_VIDEO_CONFIG`, default `video/video.yml`), schema:
   ```yaml
   schemaVersion: 1
   outputDir: video/out            # rendered MP4s (gitignored)
   browserBundle: public/videoml/browser-bundle.js
   leadSlugs: []                   # optional: slugs rendered by `videos seed` without --slug
   scene:
     dark:  { background: "#191918", color: "#eeeeec", vars: { "--color-accent": "#e54d2e" } }
     light: { background: "#ffffff", color: "#111111", vars: {} }
   components: { titleSlide: "ti-title-slide", quoteCard: "ti-quote-card" }   # custom element names registered by the brand bundle
   tts: { provider: openai }       # keys stay in .papyrus/config.yaml / env, never in this file
   ```
   `load_video_config(path) -> VideoConfig` validates and names the bad key on error. `TI_SCENE_STYLES_DARK` becomes `scene.dark` in the TI repo's config (not in Papyrus).
2. CLI: keep `papyrus videos render|seed|attach` with the same flags (read `videos_commands.py` flags and keep their names), repoint `cli.py` imports to `papyrus_content.videoml.commands` (lazy, in the `videos:*` branches), `videos seed` resolves content through the CMS (`Item` with `editorial.videoScript`, see `lib/video-script.ts` in TI: `videomlItemSlug(slug) = "<slug>--videoml"`) instead of `publications/threat_intelligence/seed/seed-edition-content.json`; `videos attach` writes the rendered MP4 as a `MediaAsset` (`type: "video"`, `role: "lead"`, `storagePath: "media/videos/<slug>.mp4"`, uploaded with `media_store.S3MediaStore` from `PPY-22a3b4`/`PPY-1d0f3d`) using the contract that `lib/graphql-content-repository.ts` `normalizeVideoAsset` (L796+) already reads.
3. Delete `publications/threat_intelligence/videoml/*.py` from Papyrus (the TS bundle files stay until `PPY-961956`) and `from publications.threat_intelligence...` imports; `pyproject.toml` needs no `publications` include (already removed).
4. Skill: add `skills/produce-video/SKILL.md` to Papyrus with the GENERIC parts of TI's skill (pipeline stages, narration rules, no pre-roll, post-roll contract); brand-specific voice/colors stay in the publication's own skill that links to it.
5. Docs: `docs/video-pipeline.md` (generic version of TI's doc; no `~/Projects` paths).

## Data shapes
`VideoConfig` as above. `videos seed --slug <slug> [--dry-run] [--probe-only]` unchanged flags. Rendered artifact path: `<outputDir>/<slug>.mp4` + `<slug>.dark.mp4` / `<slug>.light.mp4` if the pipeline already makes theme variants (keep whatever TI main does; `ArticleVideoAsset.themeVariants` in `lib/articles.ts` is the consumer).

## Tests
- Port TI's `test_video_pipeline.py` to `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_videoml_pipeline.py` (unittest; drop anything needing network/TTS/render; subprocess calls are stubbed): DSL generation for a fixture article, config loading and validation errors, command resolution order (env > node_modules), `attach` writes the expected `MediaAsset` fields to a `FakeAuthoringClient` (`PPY-b3a10e`) and uploads via a `DirMediaStore`.
- Gherkin (behave): `features_backend/videos-commands.feature` ("Rendering without a video config explains what is missing", "Attaching a rendered video registers it as lead media", "The VideoML CLI is located from the publication's node_modules") with steps using stubs.
- Real render is NOT in CI. Manual proof for the PR (needs the OpenAI key from `.papyrus/config.yaml`, ~minutes): render ONE short article video end to end in a scratch publication dir and paste the `ffprobe` duration; if no key is available say so and mark the manual proof pending.

## Acceptance checks
- `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.test_videoml_pipeline -v`, `poetry run behave features_backend/videos-commands.feature` pass.
- `pip install dist-packages/*.whl` in a clean venv: `python -c "import papyrus_content.videoml"` works and `papyrus videos render --help`-equivalent usage prints without `ModuleNotFoundError` (the `PPY-78e818` smoke test covers import of `cli`).
- `rg -n "threat|TI_|~/Projects|Babulus" src/papyrus_content/videoml` has no matches.

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-78e818` (wheel smoke) and `PPY-672ea6` (no `publications` imports; `brand.video` slot is defined in `PPY-961956`, but the Python config is independent). Soft: `PPY-22a3b4`/`PPY-1d0f3d` for `media_store.py`. Parallel with everything else except `cli.py` conflicts.

## Risks
- Largest unknown: TI main's `video_pipeline.py` has evolved since Papyrus's copy (56 KB vs ~35 KB); expect a real merge of behavior, not a copy. Budget accordingly (this is why the estimate is large).
- Dependence on external services (OpenAI TTS, `@videoml/cli` rendering with Playwright/Chromium) makes end-to-end CI impractical; unit tests stub them.
- TI's Phase 3 de-fork must wait for this ticket's CLI surface to be stable.
- Narration voice caveat from the Pilobol.us work: the Batch TTS path can silently substitute a stock voice; keep the voice an explicit config value and fail if the provider reports a different voice (check what TI main does).

## Needs Ryan
Confirm VideoML 1.0.0 (`@videoml/cli`) is the intended standard toolchain and that the OpenAI TTS key lives per publication (not in Papyrus). If TI main's pipeline depends on unpublished Babulus features, tell which.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-085f79-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
right_now_summary: The VideoML pipeline is being moved into Papyrus with publication-specific configuration and CLI support.
